source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [list(row) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i == 0 or row != grid[i - 1]]
    if not rows:
        return []
    keep = [0]
    for j in range(1, len(rows[0])):
        if any(row[j] != row[j - 1] for row in rows):
            keep.append(j)
    return [[row[j] for j in keep] for row in rows]
